source: the user's own SBML model (supplied/petab_original/model.xml, built in COPASI for the user's thesis), restructured WITH the user on 2026-09-29 by curation/build_network.py: `species` and `interactions` are the ROUND-1 MODEL (7 core + 9 provisional reactions); `hypotheses` are the structural alternatives the user wants declared, with the reactions they use in `hypothesis_reactions` and `hypothesis_species`
units: amounts are fractions of the total measured label at t = 0 (dimensionless); time in minutes. The SBML declares no time unit; the data are in minutes

species.name: labelled free fatty acid pool (all labelled FFA species, mostly palmitate; also the acyl donor for ceramide synthesis)
sphingosine-1-phosphate (not measured)
species.initial_value_source: SBML 1e-09 mol/L divided by the mean t = 0 total (1170.53 pmol in 1 mL)

species.name: hexadecenal
species.note: PLACEHOLDER in the round-1 model: measured, but no reaction reaches it until an aldehyde hypothesis (H2a/H2b/H3a/H3b) adds one; predicted flat at its t = 0 value until then.

species.name: hexadecanal
species.note: PLACEHOLDER in the round-1 model: measured, but no reaction reaches it until an aldehyde hypothesis (H2a/H2b/H3a/H3b) adds one; predicted flat at its t = 0 value until then.

interactions.note: N-acylation of sphinganine by (dihydro)ceramide synthase, with the fatty acyl taken from the FFA pool; bimolecular mass action (thesis Fig. 1, Table S2).
sphingomyelinase. Added by the user when hand simulations of the network without it let ceramide decay faster than measured (thesis 3.4.2).
glucosylceramide synthase; HexCer is the measured hexosylceramide pool (thesis Fig. 1).
degradation of ceramide to S1P: ceramidase (Cer -> sphingosine) and sphingosine kinase collapsed into one step; sphingosine itself is not in the model (thesis Fig. 1, Fig. 9).
loss of FFA label to processes outside the model. CORE by the user's decision: fatty acids have other functions than sphingolipid metabolism (thesis 3.4.1 for the original sink).

fatty acid incorporation into cholesteryl ester; CE, DG and PC are in the model as the three most abundant labelled classes outside the sphingolipid pathway at t = 0 (thesis 3.4.1). Activation and acyltransfer collapsed into one step. PROVISIONAL (user): fitted from round 1; its removal is a hypothesis to declare now and test from the first expansion, not in round 1.

fatty acid incorporation into diacylglycerol; see Pal____CE for why DG is in the model. Activation and acyltransfer collapsed into one step. PROVISIONAL (user): fitted from round 1; its removal is a hypothesis to declare now and test from the first expansion, not in round 1.

fatty acid incorporation into phosphatidylcholine; see Pal____CE for why PC is in the model. Several steps collapsed into one. PROVISIONAL (user): fitted from round 1; its removal is a hypothesis to declare now and test from the first expansion, not in round 1.

HexCer onward to complex sphingolipids or other unspecified processes (thesis Fig. 1, 3.4.1). PROVISIONAL (user): fitted from round 1; its removal is a hypothesis to declare now and test from the first expansion, not in round 1.

constant (zero-order) appearance of label in the FFA pool from unspecified processes (thesis 3.4.1); rate law as in the SBML, independent of any species. PROVISIONAL (user): fitted from round 1; its removal is a hypothesis to declare now and test from the first expansion, not in round 1.
loss of CE label to unspecified processes (thesis 3.4.1). PROVISIONAL (user): fitted from round 1; its removal is a hypothesis to declare now and test from the first expansion, not in round 1.
loss of PC label to unspecified processes (thesis 3.4.1). PROVISIONAL (user): fitted from round 1; its removal is a hypothesis to declare now and test from the first expansion, not in round 1.
loss of DG label to unspecified processes (thesis 3.4.1). PROVISIONAL (user): fitted from round 1; its removal is a hypothesis to declare now and test from the first expansion, not in round 1.

constant (zero-order) import of sphinganine label during the chase, e.g. from tracer left outside or on the cells after the pulse. Added by the user (2026-09-29) as the alternative to de novo synthesis (Pal + Ser -> Sph); PROVISIONAL. hypothesis_reactions.note: hypothesis H1: ceramide degradation that releases the fatty acid into the FFA pool (ceramidase + sphingosine kinase collapsed; sphingosine not measured). Replaces Cer_to_S1P; same parameter.
the fatty aldehyde returns to the fatty acid pool, so sphingoid-base label can re-enter lipid synthesis (thesis Fig. 9; PC labelled from alkyne sphinganine, section 3.1.1).
hexadecenal to hexadecanal, as drawn in the supplied network (thesis Fig. 9).
hypothesis H2b: hexadecenal oxidised to the fatty acid pool directly (literature route).

de novo synthesis: serine + palmitoyl-CoA by serine palmitoyltransferase and reduction of 3-ketosphinganine, collapsed into one step (thesis Fig. 1, Fig. 9, Table S2). Serine is not measured and held constant.
S1P lyase acting on sphingosine-1-phosphate, giving hexadecenal (thesis Fig. S1).
S1P lyase acting on sphinganine-1-phosphate, giving hexadecanal (thesis Fig. 1).
hypothesis H3b: sphinganine degradation to hexadecanal with the phosphorylation (SA1P) and S1P-lyase steps collapsed into one.
sphingosine kinase acting on sphinganine (thesis Fig. 1).
